environment.gs_submission: GT4_GS_SYNC=0 default (asynchronous); GT4_GS_SYNC=1 restores the fully synchronous path (launcher records the value in the session result)

The launcher refuses other values and records both names in result.json (pacing_environment).

limits: The window path was not launched by the agent: presents were exercised only on a hidden test window.
The headless schedule has menus only; 480p races at 4x/8x/16x are checked by the fixture sizes and the owner.
GT4 menus are drawn by texture blits, so super-sampling adds little there; 3D race scenes are where it shows.
GT4's own 480p DISPLAY register values are not logged yet (the fixture uses the standard MAGH=1, DW=1279).
First race start compiles pipelines synchronously (about 0.47 s in the owner session of 10:35); no persistent pipeline cache yet.
Save states are refused with GT4_RENDERER=parallel.

renderer.environment: GT4_RENDERER=parallel|donor, set by the launcher (--renderer, default parallel); inherited GT4_RENDERER and GT4_PGS_* values are removed
renderer.window_output: Granite WSI swapchain on the game window; paraLLEl-GS vsync scanout at 1x, phase = donor CSR.FIELD, force_progressive and anti_blur on; cleared to black, blitted with nearest filtering into the same 16:9 rectangle as the donor presenter; GT4_PRESENT_MODE maps fifo/mailbox/immediate

Blit filter: nearest for 1x and exact integer upscales, linear otherwise.
